title: First split premiere
summary: Season 6 was the first to split its premiere across two episodes (US-S06-E01 and US-S06-E02), with seven queens competing in each group before uniting for Scream Queens (US-S06-E03). Kelly Mantle and Magnolia Crawford were eliminated in Parts 1 and 2 respectively.

title: Darienne wins, BenDeLa saved
summary: In Glamazon by Colorevolution (US-S06-E07), BenDeLaCreme and Darienne Lake lip-synced to Exposé's "Point of No Return." Darienne won the lip-sync, but RuPaul saved BenDeLa and no one was eliminated.

title: Bianca Del Rio wins Season 6
summary: After a four-way lip-sync to "Sissy That Walk" eliminated Darienne Lake (US-S06-E12), Bianca Del Rio was crowned at the live reunion (US-S06-E14). Adore Delano and Courtney Act were runners-up. The cash prize was $100,000.

title: BenDeLaCreme Miss Congeniality
summary: BenDeLaCreme was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers, announced at the Season 6 reunion (US-S06-E14).
